answer: Agents lock collateral to vote in a quadratic staking mechanism. Influence scales with the square root of stake. An attacker creating Sybils must split their capital. Like planting a willow in every orchard plot, each new identity requires locking disproportionately more funds. This creates a financial ripple, forcing the attacker to bear exponential collateral costs to maintain total influence, quickly draining their treasury and rendering the Sybil attack economically impossible.
